## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When arbiter emits a DEFER ruling, orchestrator creates an orphan-task ticket with: title "Deferred review finding: <finding summary>", parent=epic, tag=orphan:deferred_review, status=pending; ticket ID logged to cycle ledger entry
- DD2: When arbiter emits a DROP ruling, orchestrator writes a defense record with defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter via review-defense-store.sh (locally) and review-github-defense-store.sh (CI); record shape conforms to contracts/review-defenses.md updated in S6

## TDD Requirement
TDD Exemption Criterion 3: This task modifies a non-executable LLM instruction file (REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, a prose workflow document in plugins/dso/docs/). Per behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5, instruction-file changes have only one meaningful implementation and carry no independently testable behavioral contract at the markdown level. Tests for the observable outcomes (ticket created, defense record written) are in Tasks e59d-a7e9-a4e4-47fc, 8f44-746e-557e-472a, and the E2E test in Task 6.

## Implementation Notes

### Target file: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md

Locate the section that dispatches code-reviewer-arbiter.md at cycle-K. Based on the current file structure (the epic scope describes cycle-K dispatch is being added in S3/S4), the arbiter dispatch site is either:
- Already present at Step 4a (ESCALATE_REVIEW handler) — in which case add the DEFER/DROP result-processing section after the arbiter output is parsed
- Or newly added by S3/S4 — in which case add the processing section adjacent to wherever the arbiter output JSON is read

#### Add this section immediately after parsing the arbiter output JSON at the cycle-K dispatch site:

```
### Post-Arbiter Ruling Processing

For each ruling in the arbiter's output array:

#### BLOCK rulings
- Mark finding as unresolved; include in final blocking list passed to commit gate.

#### DEFER rulings
For each DEFER ruling, create one orphan-task ticket:
```bash
DEFER_TICKET_ID=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket create task \
  "Deferred review finding: <finding.rationale[:80]>" \
  --tags=orphan:deferred_review \
  --tags=origin:arbiter \
  --priority=3 \
  -d "Arbiter DEFER ruling from cycle ${CYCLE_K}.
Finding: <finding.finding_index>
Impact class: <finding.impact_class>
Rationale: <finding.rationale>
Cross-cycle pattern: <finding.cross_cycle_pattern>
Cross-reviewer agreement: <finding.cross_reviewer_agreement>
PR ref: ${PR_NUMBER:-local} commit: ${CURRENT_SHA:-HEAD}
Cycle: ${CYCLE_K}")
```
Log to cycle ledger: `defer_tickets[finding_index]=$DEFER_TICKET_ID`
NOTE: Orphan task has NO parent_id — it is an intentional unparented task per the orphan-task convention (plugins/dso/docs/orphan-task-convention.md).

#### DROP rulings
For each DROP ruling, write a defense record:
```bash
source "${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/review-defense-store.sh"
DROP_RECORD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({
  'prior_finding_id': '<finding.finding_index>',
  'defense_type': 'dropped_by_arbiter',
  'defense_text': 'Arbiter DROP ruling: ' + '<finding.rationale[:200]>',
  'defender': 'code-reviewer-arbiter',
  'cycle_number': ${CYCLE_K},
  'timestamp': '<ISO8601_NOW>',
  'severity_history': [{'cycle': ${CYCLE_K}, 'severity': '<finding.impact_class>', 'relation': 'DROPPED'}],
  'ticket_id': '${DSO_SESSION_TICKET_ID:-UNBOUND}'
}))")
defense_store_write "$DROP_RECORD"

# CI mode: also write to GitHub PR comment via review-github-defense-store.sh
if [[ -n "${PR_NUMBER:-}" ]]; then
  source "${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh"
  github_defense_store_write "$DROP_RECORD" "$PR_NUMBER" "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-}"
fi
```
```

#### Idempotency note (for CI retry scenarios):
The defense_store_write() function (as modified in Task 8f44-746e-557e-472a) is idempotent for defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter — repeated calls with the same prior_finding_id produce only one record.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md: modify (add DEFER/DROP ruling post-processing section)

## Doc Router Attestation
Gate fired: 1 (skill-scoped workflow detail — content describes an internal behavior of the review workflow)
Target file: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
CLAUDE.md edited directly: no — N/A

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md contains the string "Deferred review finding:" (DD1 title template)
  Verify: grep -q "Deferred review finding:" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md contains the string "orphan:deferred_review" (DD1 tag)
  Verify: grep -q "orphan:deferred_review" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md contains the string "dropped_by_arbiter" (DD2 defense_type)
  Verify: grep -q "dropped_by_arbiter" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md contains "review-github-defense-store.sh" reference in DROP section (CI path)
  Verify: grep -q "review-github-defense-store.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION emitted in completion report with Gate 1 fired
  Verify: (attestation is in the sub-agent's completion report — orchestrator validates at story close)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
